title: The West End Museum

services.name: Schedule a Tour
services.desc: You can schedule a rental of the Museum by emailing rentals@thewestendmuseum.org or though Peerspace. Rental rates vary based on time, location within the Museum, size of event, any closures of the Museum during regular operating hours, and the like. Events with alcohol must be scheduled far enough in advance that the necessary permits can be obtained. This usually takes 2-4 weeks. blurb: Uncover the little known stories of the queer residents of the West End of Boston. From artists and authors to activists and brothel owners, the West End has been home to a number of trendsetters, leaders, and artists who embraced a life outside the norm.
